extracted.name: Zesty & crunchy sprout slaw
extracted.description: Have this sprout slaw up your sleeve for the festive period. Serve with ham or leftover meat in a sandwich, or simply in a big bowl topped with nuts or feta
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp mixed seeds (we used pumpkin, sunflower and linseed)
800g Brussels sprouts halved and finely shaved on a mandoline
1 small red onion halved and thinly sliced
small bunch of mint leaves picked and finely chopped
instruction_lines: Combine the dressing ingredients in a large bowl with a pinch of salt. Toast the almonds in a dry frying pan over a low heat until golden, about 1-2 mins, then tip onto a plate and leave to cool. Toast the seeds in the same way for 1-2 mins until they pop, ensuring they don’t catch. Leave to cool with the almonds.

Tip the sprouts into the bowl with the dressing. Add the onion, mint, cranberries, almonds and seeds, then toss to coat. If making ahead, toss the salad ingredients together, then dress just before serving.
